newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AAA-
Daihachi Chemical Industry Co Ltd (unlisted), 10 million Swiss francs unsecured due 2001, private placement, guaranteed by Sumitomo Bank
Santen Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Toyo Chemical Co Ltd, 30 million Swiss francs unsecured with warrants due 2000, private placement, guaranteed by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank
-BB-
Kuraya Corp, 20 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2008
Maruzen Showa Unyu Co Ltd, seven billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Morinaga Milk Industry Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Senshu Electric Co Ltd, two billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Takara Standard Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Orix Corp, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2001
Sumitomo Wiring Systems Ltd, seven billion yen unsecured convertible due 2008
Teikoku Piston Ring Co Ltd, four billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement
Toli Corp, seven billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
Yamaki Co Ltd, three billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003
-CCC-
Shimpo Industrial Co Ltd, 4.5 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement
